suites.title: TAQ · market data
suites.dataset: One simulated market day: 9.4M quotes, 0.6M trades, sorted by symbol and time
suites.note: 53 queries over the NYSETAQBenchmarks in-memory suite: filters, aggregations, per-symbol windows, asof joins, OHLC bars. Best of three runs per query, 8 threads, all engines over the same Parquet input.

suites.title: ClickBench · web analytics
suites.dataset: 10M-row subset of the public ClickBench hits dataset
suites.note: The standard 43 ClickBench queries; each engine queries its own in-memory representation of the same rows (keyten its native store, polars a scanned Parquet, duckdb an in-memory table). Warm, best of three per query.

suites.title: PDS-H SF10 · decision support
suites.dataset: PDS-H (TPC-H derived) at scale factor 10 — 60M-row lineitem
suites.note: 22 decision-support queries via the polars-benchmark harness, in-memory ("skip") IO for every engine. Best of three per query after a warm-up pass. Derived from TPC-H; results are not comparable to official TPC results.
